change: The fixed 64 KiB home response probe now requires both an HTML marker and a title containing the currently configured canonical site title www.pawelperfect.com. MIME-correct HTML titled Gateway error is rejected before measurement.
limitations: The probe is a single pre-measurement request to numeric loopback; home body remains discarded by k6 during measured requests.
The title check is bounded to the first 64 KiB and does not parse/validate the complete HTML document.
No k6 load, real app/server, DB, proxy, production target, image decoder or deployment cleanup was run.
